children.name: Netskope - Application Detail
children.description: Application Details Dashboard provides a high-level view of data for unique applications used, as well as top applications by alerts, bytes, and average page duration. This dashboard also provides a visual breakdown of applications by category, devices by user access, and network usage over time.

panels.name: Applications by Activity Distribution
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "nspolicy" "no" 
| json "_id", "alert", "alert_type", "type", "srcip", "dstip", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "acked", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "activity", "browser", "object", "object_type", "from_user", "to_user" as alert_id, is_alert, alert_type, type, src_ip, dest_ip, appcategory, app, os, user, device, acked, site, timestamp, ccl, activity, browser, object, object_type, from_user, to_user nodrop| where is_alert="no" and isNull(alert_type) and type="nspolicy"
| if(isNull(activity), "Unknown", activity) as activity
| count by activity, app
| total _count as activity_count by app
| transpose row app, activity_count column activity
| sort by activity_count

panels.name: Top 10 Applications by Total Alerts
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope ("DLP" OR "anomaly" OR "Malware" OR "Compromised Credentials") "yes" 
| json "_id", "srcip", "dstip", "alert", "alert_name", "alert_type", "appcategory", "category", "app", "site", "os", "user", "device", "acked" as alert_id, src_ip, dest_ip, is_alert, alert_name, alert_type, appcategory, category, app, site, os, user, device, acked nodrop
| where is_alert="yes" and alert_type in ("DLP", "anomaly", "Malware", "Compromised Credentials")
| count by alert_type, {{GROUP_BY_FIELD}}
| total _count as total_alerts by {{GROUP_BY_FIELD}}
| transpose row {{GROUP_BY_FIELD}}, total_alerts column alert_type
| sort by total_alerts
| limit 10

panels.name: Top 10 Applications by Total Bytes
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "page"
| json "_id", "alert", "app_session_id", "browser", "bypass_traffic", "client_bytes", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "domain", "http_transaction_count","num_bytes","server_bytes", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "traffic_type", "type", "url", "page", "page_duration", "hostname", "req_cnt", "resp_cnt" as event_id, alert, app_session_id, browser, bypass_traffic, client_bytes, appcategory, app, os, user, device, domain, http_transaction_count,num_bytes,server_bytes, site, timestamp, ccl, traffic_type, type, url, page, page_duration, hostname, req_cnt, resp_cnt nodrop
| where isNull(alert) and type="page" and !isNull({{GROUP_BY_FIELD}})
| count by {{GROUP_BY_FIELD}}, appcategory, ccl, client_bytes, server_bytes, user, app_session_id, page_duration
| sum(client_bytes) as upload_bytes, sum(server_bytes) as download_bytes, count(user) as user_count, count(app_session_id) as session_count, avg(page_duration) as avg_page_duration by {{GROUP_BY_FIELD}}, appcategory, ccl
| upload_bytes/1024/1024 as upload_bytes_MB
| download_bytes/1024/1024 as download_bytes_sumMB
| upload_bytes_MB+download_bytes_sumMB as total_bytes_sumMB
| fields -upload_bytes, download_bytes
| sort by {{SORT_BY}}
| limit 10

panels.name: Top 10 Users
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "page"
| json "_id", "alert", "app_session_id", "browser", "bypass_traffic", "client_bytes", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "domain", "http_transaction_count","num_bytes","server_bytes", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "traffic_type", "type", "url", "page", "page_duration", "hostname", "req_cnt", "resp_cnt" as event_id, alert, app_session_id, browser, bypass_traffic, client_bytes, appcategory, app, os, user, device, domain, http_transaction_count,num_bytes,server_bytes, site, timestamp, ccl, traffic_type, type, url, page, page_duration, hostname, req_cnt, resp_cnt nodrop
| where isNull(alert) and type="page" and !isNull(user)
| count by user, device, client_bytes, server_bytes, app, app_session_id, site
| sum(client_bytes) as upload_bytes, sum(server_bytes) as download_bytes, count_distinct(app) as app_count, count_distinct(app_session_id) as session_count, count_distinct(device) as device_count, count_distinct(site) as site_count by user
| upload_bytes/1024/1024 as upload_bytes_sumMB
| download_bytes/1024/1024 as download_bytes_sumMB
| upload_bytes_sumMB+download_bytes_sumMB as total_bytes_sumMB
| fields -upload_bytes, download_bytes
| sort by {{SORT_USER_BY}} 
| limit 10

panels.name: Top 10 Users by Total Alerts
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "yes" ("DLP" OR "anomaly" OR "Malware" OR "Compromised Credential")
| json "_id", "alert", "alert_type", "user" nodrop
| where alert="yes" and alert_type in ("DLP", "anomaly", "Malware", "Compromised Credential")
| count by alert_type, user
| total _count as total_alerts by user
| transpose row user, total_alerts column alert_type
| sort by total_alerts
| limit 10

panels.name: Browser Distribution by User
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "no" "nspolicy"
| json "_id", "alert", "alert_type", "type", "srcip", "dstip", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "acked", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "activity", "browser", "object", "object_type", "from_user", "to_user" as alert_id, is_alert, alert_type, type, src_ip, dest_ip, appcategory, app, os, user, device, acked, site, timestamp, ccl, activity, browser, object, object_type, from_user, to_user nodrop
| where is_alert="no" and isNull(alert_type) and type="nspolicy"
| count by user,browser 
| count(user) by browser 
| sort by _count

panels.name: User Activity Distribution
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "no" "nspolicy"
| json "_id", "alert", "alert_type", "type", "srcip", "dstip", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "acked", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "activity", "browser", "object", "object_type", "from_user", "to_user" as alert_id, is_alert, alert_type, type, src_ip, dest_ip, appcategory, app, os, user, device, acked, site, timestamp, ccl, activity, browser, object, object_type, from_user, to_user nodrop
| where is_alert="no" and isNull(alert_type) and type="nspolicy"
| if(isNull(activity), "Unknown", activity) as activity
| count by activity
| sort by _count

panels.name: Recent User Activity
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "no" "nspolicy"
| json "_id", "alert", "alert_type", "type", "srcip", "dstip", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "activity", "browser", "object", "object_type", "from_user", "to_user", "traffic_type" as alert_id, is_alert, alert_type, type, src_ip, dest_ip, appcategory, app, os, user, device, site, timestamp, ccl, activity, browser, object, object_type, from_user, to_user, traffic_type nodrop
| where is_alert="no" and isNull(alert_type) and type="nspolicy"
| count by timestamp, app, user, activity, object, object_type, traffic_type, site, os, browser, from_user, to_user
| sort by timestamp
| formatDate(fromMillis(toLong(timestamp*1000)),"MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS") as alert_date
| fields alert_date, app, user, activity, from_user, to_user, object, object_type, traffic_type, site, os, browser
